guide.title: Mod installation guide
guide.sub: How to install {mod} for Don't Starve Together.

subscribe.title: Subscribe to the mod
subscribe.desc: Open the mod's Steam Workshop page and click Subscribe. Steam will download it automatically.

enable.title: Enable the mod in game
enable.desc: From the main menu choose Mods, find {mod} and enable it.

world.title: Create or open a world
world.desc: When creating a world, open the world's Mods tab and enable this mod.

friends.title: Play with friends
friends.desc: Every player needs the mod, so the game downloads it for your friends automatically when they join.

compat.title: Compatibility note
compat.desc: {mod} is not compatible with mods that add characters beyond the game's 18 original characters. Disable those mods before playing.

autoDownload.q: Do players joining someone else's server need to install the mod?
autoDownload.a: Usually not: the game downloads the mod when they join, as long as it is enabled on that world.

notShowing.a: Make sure you are subscribed and Steam has finished downloading. Restart the game.

otherCharacters.q: Can I use it with other character mods?
otherCharacters.a: No. {mod} only supports the game's 18 original characters, so disable any mods that add other characters.

community.title: Community
community.desc: Join our Discord to ask questions, report bugs and share feedback on the mod.
